name: IWC (bare tools): a plain question over the user's data finds a community workflow
description: Runs under LOOM_GALAXY_TOOLS=bare (and its ORBIT_ spelling, which readEnv prefers if the ambient env sets it), so the Galaxy tools are galaxy-ops operations registered in-process under bare names. Same question as iwc-find-from-question: the user asks about their own data and never says 'plan' or 'Galaxy', so this tests that the registry check isn't gated behind a plan request on the bare path. Asserts the agent ranked IWC workflows through recommend_iwc_workflows (and the family-aware iwc-candidates hint rode along), and noticed that the top hit starts from count tables while the user has reads. Bare-path clone of iwc-find-from-question; the original covers the MCP path until 2e deletes it.
inputs: I have paired-end RNA-seq from six mouse liver samples, three treated and three control, and I want to know which genes changed.
